title: Photo Booth Hire Chelmsford | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Chelmsford for barn weddings, proms and Christmas parties across the Essex villages. Attendant and prints from £299. Get a quote.
intro: Chelmsford mixes city-centre hotels with a ring of barn wedding venues in the villages, and our team is in and out of both every weekend. Expect a booth, a professional attendant, props and unlimited prints, with the build done before the hire starts and packages from £299.

sections.heading: From barns to ballrooms: Chelmsford venue types
paragraphs: Essex is barn-wedding country and the villages around Chelmsford, from Writtle and Broomfield to Boreham and Danbury, have more converted barns than almost anywhere else we work. The city centre has hotels with function suites, racecourse and showground-style venues on the edge of town host larger events, golf clubs are popular for weddings and proms, and parkland venues with marquee lawns take summer receptions. Cricket and sports clubs, village halls and community centres host birthdays, christenings and fundraisers.

sections.heading: Barn weddings, proms and Christmas parties
paragraphs: A barn wedding needs a little forethought for a booth. Floors can be flagstone or timber, power is usually at the edges of the room, and the booth needs to be far enough from the band for guests to hear the attendant. We ask for the socket location and a floor plan, tape cables down and build during the meal so the booth is ready when the dancing starts.

Chelmsford's prom season runs through late June and early July, mostly at hotels and golf clubs, and the schools often want their crest on every print. Christmas parties begin in late November and run right up to the holidays; office parties, sports club dinners and family gatherings all want a festive overlay and a prop box to match, and December dates go quickly, so an early deposit is wise.
list: Barns: socket position and floor plan in advance
Proms: school crest on the template, strict finish time
Christmas parties: book before November for December dates
Marquees: level ground and a weatherproof power supply

sections.heading: Getting the booth in and built
paragraphs: Barn venues almost always have a gravel car park or a yard close to the door, which suits us well. City-centre hotels may direct us to a loading bay or service entrance; parts of the centre are pedestrianised, so we never rely on street parking and always agree the unloading point beforehand. Marquee venues need a track a vehicle can reach and a reliable power feed, which we confirm with the venue.

The build takes 45 to 60 minutes and is finished before the hire window begins, with no charge for that time. One standard socket is enough for most booths. Few barns have stairs, but hotel function rooms sometimes do, and a quick note at booking means we bring the right kit.

sections.heading: Chelmsford and the Essex villages
paragraphs: Chelmsford is the county city of Essex and the heart of our Essex coverage. We cover the city centre, Springfield, Great Baddow, Writtle, Broomfield, Boreham and Danbury, and head out to Brentwood, Braintree, Witham, Maldon, Ingatestone and South Woodham Ferrers regularly. The A12, A130 and A414 link everything, and delivery and setup are free. A travel contribution would only ever be considered for a truly remote venue and would appear on the quote up front.

sections.heading: Which booths work for Chelmsford events
paragraphs: The Magic Mirror is the most booked booth for Chelmsford weddings, especially in barns with rustic timber and soft lighting, where the full-length mirror looks striking. The Retro Pod, with inbuilt printer and classic strip prints, suits the same venues on a smaller budget and keeps cabling to a minimum on uneven floors. The Inflatable Booth makes a statement at larger receptions and Christmas parties where the glow can be set to the theme colour, and the LCD SlimPod is the budget-friendly choice for proms and birthdays.

Every booth comes with an attendant, a box of props and a template designed around your names, school crest or company logo. Print booths add a guest book for messages, and all of them share digital copies by email on the night so guests leave with something in hand and something on their phone.

sections.heading: Prices and what you get
paragraphs: Packages begin at £299 and include a professional attendant, unlimited sessions, props, a custom print or overlay template with your text and logo, a guest book on print booths, digital copies, email and social sharing, LED lighting and public liability insurance. The deposit is £80 and the balance is due one month before the event. Ask about green screen if you want a themed backdrop; our customers rate us 5 stars on Trustpilot.

faqs.q: Where do you park and unload at a barn near Chelmsford?
faqs.a: Barn venues around Chelmsford almost always have a gravel car park or yard beside the door, so we unload there and park. City-centre hotels usually give us a loading bay or service entrance, and we agree it before the day so the pedestrianised streets are not an issue.

faqs.q: What if the function room is on the first floor?
faqs.a: Tell us at booking and we will send a booth that two people can carry up the stairs, such as the LCD SlimPod or Retro Pod. The Magic Mirror and Inflatable Booth are best on the ground floor or in venues with a lift.

faqs.q: Do you charge travel to Chelmsford or the surrounding villages?
faqs.a: No. Delivery, setup and pack-down are included in the package price and Chelmsford is well within our regular area. If a travel contribution ever applied to a far-flung venue, it would be itemised on the quote up front before you commit.

faqs.q: The barn has limited power. Which booth is best?
faqs.a: The Retro Pod is ideal: its inbuilt printer means one socket and almost no cabling. The LCD SlimPod and Magic Mirror also run from a single socket. Send us the socket position and we will place the booth where the cable run is shortest and safest.

faqs.q: Can the booth go in a marquee on a parkland lawn?
faqs.a: Yes, provided there is a solid level floor and a reliable power feed to a standard socket. We keep the booth away from open sides for weather protection and tape all cables down. Confirm the power arrangements with the marquee company and we will do the rest.
